CLOSED 2026-08-23 (was REINFORCED 2026-08-18; opened 2026-04-25, 120 days) - Re-verify @lingui/swc-plugin swc_core ABI compatibility through 6.6.0. ANSWER: COMPATIBLE, AND THE HAZARD NEVER EXISTED IN THE FORM THIS ITEM ASSUMED. SWC's Wasm plugin ABI has been BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE since @swc/core v1.15.0 (blog.swc.rs/2025-11-4-wasm-backward-compatibility): the rkyv serialization scheme, which required host and plugin to agree on exact AST memory layout and is the entire reason plugin/runtime pairs had to be locked, was replaced with self-describing cbor, and every AST enum gained an Unknown variant. Requires the plugin to build with swc_core >= 47 and --cfg=swc_ast_unknown. @lingui/swc-plugin adopted it at 5.10.1 (swc_core 50.2.3) and builds at swc_core 66.0.3 from 6.2.0 onward (2026-05-22), so 6.6.0 on any @swc/core 1.15.33+ host is the forward direction the guarantee covers. The 2026-08-21/22 framing (1.15 -> 1.16 = ABI break) was exactly backwards: 1.15 is where this class of breakage STOPPED. RESIDUAL WATCH ONLY: cbor does not cover AST field deletions or field type changes, and lingui/swc-plugin#179 notes they have not yet tested the new scheme against a release that changed the AST layout. What this item found on the way out is items 15 (rewritten) and 16 (new).
